summary: End-to-end regression on the new Customer Expo landing/home experience at http://localhost:3001. Bundle serves 200 on localhost (14.22MB) and via Expo tunnel (yjnus5m-anonymous-3001.exp.direct). Backend content endpoints (/api/site/homepage, /api/catalog/categories, /api/site/promotions, /api/content/testimonials, /api/content/faqs/grouped, /api/content/blogs, /api/site/config) all return 200 with expected shapes (7 homepage sections, 6 cats, 7 offers/3 coupons, stats 5-star/9 jobs/9 verified pros). Landing UI renders every required testID (landing-page, hero-title/search/stats/chips, home-cat-*, home-featured_services-*, home-trending_services-*, home-trust, home-offers, home-membership-banner, home-coupons, home-grow-cta, home-faq, home-blog, site-footer). Location gate shows on first visit and dismisses via loc-skip. Coupon copy toast for AZO50 fires correctly. Navbar mobile search opens mobile-search-modal and returns search-result-* for query 'ac'. Navbar menu -> nav-location accepts pincode 800001, badge shows 'We serve your area', nav-location-set removes home-location-hint. Auth: logged-out tab-profile -> login (with login-back-home working), phone 9000000004 + OTP 123456 -> customer-home; navbar swaps to nav-account-mobile and tab-profile shortcuts straight to customer-home. After page.reload the app opens on landing (as spec) and session persists. Partner 9000000003 + OTP 123456 is correctly blocked with 'Only Customers can sign in to the Customer App...' toast and remains on login. All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: Two DOM nodes carry data-testid="landing-page" (and correspondingly duplicate tab-profile/tab-home from MobileBottomNav) once the /(site) route has been mounted alongside another route. Tests must use .first to disambiguate. Functionally harmless but confuses automated selectors.

When CategoryServicesSheet is open on mobile viewport (390x844) with many services, the close button (category-sheet-close) is positioned outside the initial viewport for some categories; Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport'. Consider sticking the close button to the sheet header so it is always reachable without scrolling.

action_items: (LOW) Ensure only a single instance of landing-page + MobileBottomNav is mounted at any time so testIDs are unique.
(LOW) Pin category-sheet-close inside the sheet's sticky header for reliable dismissal on small viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.go() correctly routes bookings/profile to /login when logged out and /(customer) when logged in — verified end-to-end.
LocationButton persistence + pincode serviceability call to /api/geo/serviceability?pincode=800001 works and updates city header + hides home-location-hint.
Role guard in Customer/app/login.tsx blocks partner/merchant/admin/agent phones with clear toast and no token leak — verified with 9000000003.
GET /api/site/promotions returns membership_plans=[] but the home-membership-banner still renders (defaults). Confirm this is intentional or hide the banner when no plan is available.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance criteria (all landing/nav/auth flows passed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Expo app served by supervisor 'customer_expo' on :3001. All landing testIDs live under /app/Customer/app/(site)/index.tsx + /app/Customer/src/components/site/*. Login testIDs are send-otp-button/verify-otp-button/login-otp-input/login-phone-input/login-back-home (NOT login-send-otp/login-verify). MobileBottomNav renders tab-{home,services,cart,bookings,profile}. Some landing testIDs (landing-page, tab-*) may resolve to 2 elements once /(site) is remounted — use locator().first. After page.reload the router returns to /(site) landing (even if user is logged in) by design; tab-profile then routes to /(customer) without re-login. Partner/merchant/admin/agent numbers are blocked in Customer app.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Two low-priority polish items (duplicate landing-page node; category-sheet-close visibility on small viewports).
